description: This file implements the AppSecurityPermissions class, which manages and displays categorized security permissions for an Android application, including handling permission groups, individual permissions, and user interactions such as dialogs and copying permissions to clipboard.

classes.name: MyPermissionGroupInfo
classes.description: Extends PermissionGroupInfo to include label and icon loading, manages permissions within a group.

classes.name: MyPermissionInfo
classes.description: Extends PermissionInfo to include label, existing request flags, and new permission indicator.

classes.name: PermissionItemView
classes.description: Custom LinearLayout view representing a permission item, handles click and long-click interactions.

methods.name: loadGroupIcon
methods.description: Loads and tints the icon for a permission group.

methods.name: setPermission
methods.description: Initializes the PermissionItemView with permission data, sets click listeners.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Displays detailed permission info in a dialog when clicked.

methods.name: onLongClick
methods.description: Copies permission label and name to clipboard on long click.

methods.name: extractPerms
methods.description: Extracts permissions from PackageInfo, filtering displayable permissions, and organizes them into groups.

methods.name: getPermissionCount
methods.description: Returns total number of permissions, filtered by 'which' (new or all).

methods.name: getPermissionsView
methods.description: Creates and returns a view displaying permissions categorized.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Populates a layout with permission views based on categories.

methods.name: getPermissionItemView
methods.description: Creates a PermissionItemView for a specific permission.

methods.name: isDisplayablePermission
methods.description: Determines if a permission should be shown to the user based on its protection level and flags.

methods.name: addPermToList
methods.description: Inserts a permission into a sorted list maintaining order.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Organizes permissions into groups and sorts them for display.
